name: Solomon Islands
famous_for: World-renowned WWII Guadalcanal shipwreck diving, Marovo Lagoon (world's largest double barrier lagoon), and shell money.
tourists: Approx. 30,000 scuba divers and explorers; famous for Iron Bottom Sound dive wrecks and Marovo wood carvings.
must_know: Traditional shell money (Tafuliae) made of polished seashell discs is still used for ceremonial bride-price and land compensations.
fun_fact: Marovo Lagoon is framed by volcanic islands and coral atolls, praised by author James Michener as the eighth wonder of the world.
